$comment: Shared cases for every purchase-flow port. process: one processPurchase call. iapkit: confirmWithIapkit with a fake verifyPurchaseWithProvider, apiKey "pk" unless the case sets apiKey (null: none passed); props null means building the request throws. sequences: deliveries through the flow's listener (listener), processPurchase (process), or recoverPurchases (recover); each step's deliveries start together and settle before the next step. answers: confirmWithBackend results per purchase id, used in order with the last repeating; the string "throw" throws. A port compares every listed field; error: true means a thrown error or a failed status, finishError: true a status carrying one, whatever the message. device: confirmOnDeviceIOS over a fake getPendingTransactionsIOS returning pending (reads false: never called). requestedOnce: wasRequested answers true only once per listed id, like an SDK's request mark.
